sayLines.text: ◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: wave-2 monsters faced; wave-3 monsters faced; the food-thesis deeds. The climb is not over.

grants.why: The feast is warm and good — but your reactor hums its steady note underneath, and the fire never catches. 1.25x, always, is all there is. (Feast buff refused:
